svg.title: Isaac ROS Jetbot NanoOWL — system overview
svg.desc: Operators, phone and handset, off-board services, the two-Jetson k3s cluster with the ROS 2 graph, the STM32N6 microcontrollers, sensors, the map-mission path through the pilot's remote and the closed control loop.
svg.text: Isaac ROS Jetbot NanoOWL — system overview

Operators, phone and handset · two-Jetson k3s cluster running the ROS 2 graph · STM32N6 flight controller and camera on one Ethernet segment · map missions through the pilot's remote · closed control loop in red
